name: ANHEAVEN
source:
Originally intended to be a collection of three stories, due to circumstances, only one was completed.

It’s a story about a protagonist who is in despair over his gloomy everyday life, meets a girl and comes to believe she is an angel — and how the story unfolds toward its conclusion after that belief is accepted.
